name: The Long Whiteout

detectability.signature: Absence signature - a clean hole in gravimetric returns detected at 310,000 kilometers by what fails to appear

proximity: All gravimetric gradients flatten to zero on approach instruments
Starfields pass visibly unbent where lensing should occur
Drifting debris moves at unnervingly constant velocity
contact: Steering degrades to pure ballistic flight with no gravitational reference
Automated systems log continuous sensor faults and self-diagnose without end
Every change of momentum demands full thruster work
prolonged_exposure: Chronic disorientation as crews lose all inertial intuition
Accumulating calibration rot in gravimetric and inertial hardware
Psychological whiteout, a documented trance-like unease among long-stay pilots

phenomena: Background stars refracting nowhere through the entire volume
A smooth null printed across every gravity map in the sector
Dust and ice coasting in perfectly straight, unwavering lines
hazards: Total gravimetric and navigational sensor blackout
Collision courses undetectable until optical range
Crew disorientation leading to fatal piloting errors
opportunities: Invisibility to gravimetric tracking and mass-shadow interdiction
Preferred smuggling route and covert rendezvous volume
Natural laboratory for testing gravitational theory
known_incidents: 2264 - Interdiction cutter Vigilant Rose lost a marked hauler inside the null for eleven days
Three separate customs actions abandoned after patrol sensors went flat mid-operation
description: There is nothing to see at the Long Whiteout, and that is precisely its signature. Background stars pass through the region without the faintest bending, sensor maps record a smooth hole in the galaxy's gravitational weave, and drifting dust coasts through at constant, thoughtless velocity. Pilots describe the approach as stepping into a room where someone has just switched off a machine they never knew was running.

The void holds perfectly still, its boundary fixed to within a kilometer across three centuries of observation. Entering vessels find their momentum becomes eerily honest, needing no correction burns but offering no assistance, until steering is pure ballistics. Instruments calibrated for a living universe read zero on every gradient, and inexperienced helms have drifted for days convinced their thrusters had failed.

The Cartographic Synod logged the Whiteout in 2219 while auditing why one mail lane's timings kept beating prediction. Smugglers discovered the region's real value soon after: inside the null, gravimetric trackers and mass-shadow nets are blind. At least three interdiction operations have ended in embarrassment here, patrol cutters circling a cargo hauler sitting quiet as a held breath.

The void's permanence unsettles theorists more than any storm would; gravity wells die, but absences are not supposed to endure. Surveys have found no debris, no boundary phenomenon, and no explanation. The traffic charts mark it in patient gray ink: safe passage, no services rendered, nothing here will catch you, and nothing here will help.
